answer: Operator quotas tied to payment instruments: every agent must be registered under an operator who verified a distinct bank card, and each card may sponsor at most three agents per month. An honest builder on the terrace of a small startup never hits the cap. A sybil farmer needs thousands of real cards, each costing fees, chargeback risk and identity checks, so the farm's nectar dries up before it reaches the jetty of payouts, and one flagged card freezes all agents it sponsored.
